settings.heading: Find what fits your world.
settings.intro: A simple guide to exploring the Quadratum collection.

settings.title: Start with the category.
settings.body: Browse the collections, use filters where available and sort products to narrow your selection.

settings.title: Look at the details.
settings.body: Compare the images, dimensions, materials and available options on the individual product page. Product-specific information takes priority over general guidance.

settings.title: Keep a shortlist.
settings.body: Save the products that catch your eye and return to compare them. Open your saved products.

settings.title: Need a hand?
settings.body: Contact us with the product name and your question.
